data.retirementDetails: Der Strom- & Erdgasverbrauch 2020 der VNG Gasspeicher GmbH wurde durch den Erwerb und die Entwertung von Verified Emission Reductions (VER) Zertifikaten klimaneutral gestellt. Durch diese freiwillige Kompensation mit verifizierten Emissionsreduktionen werden die entstandenen CO2-Emissionen durch Ausgleichs-Maßnahmen für den Klimaschutz kompensiert. Die Kompensation erfolgt dabei nach Ablauf des Monitoring-Zeitraums. Die Ermittlung der Emissionen erfolgt durch eigene Berechnungen. VNG Gasspeicher GmbH voluntarily bought and used Verified Emission Reductions (VER) certificates to offset its 2020 energy and natural gas consumption. This means that the CO2-emissions of 2020 are being compensated through appropriate compensatory measures for protecting our climate. The compensation happens after the monitoring period. The emissions are determined through own calculations.

data.retirementDetails: Este certificado atesta a neutralização de 200 ton CO2 através da aposentadoria de VCUs emitidas pelo Verified Carbon Standard. A neutralização das emissões de gases de efeito estufa ocorreu no âmbito de um programa de eficiência energética promovido entre os clientes da distribuidora de eletricidade Energisa através da instalação de duchas fornecidas pela Hydra. Para executar a gestão do programa, a Energisa contratou a plataforma de coalizão da ZCO2 que utiliza blockchain para engajar cidadãos e empresas no combate às mudanças climáticas. / This certificate attests the offsetting of 200 tons CO2 by retiring VCUs issued under the Verified Carbon Standard. The offsetting initiative occurred within an energy efficiency program sponsored by the electricity utility Energisa through the installation of 200 electric showers supplied by Hydra. Energisa retained ZCO2 blockchain platform to manage the program. ZCO2 runs a coalition platform of citizens engaged in combating climate change.
